row1 ordinary unarmored crab crouching, claws together; ordinary houses still unchanged (castle is cream castle only, never shipping-box hybrid).
row2 anticipation: eyes lowered; box flaps hinge upward revealing folded interior; soda pull-tab raises and rim begins rotation; castle pennant lowers and tower hinges begin opening.
row3 visibly HALF-ASSEMBLED upgrades: box partly folded into workshop, engineer vest halfway folded onto body; soda side pods half extended, collar closing, goggles being lowered above eyes; castle observatory roof halfway unfolded, short cape settling on shoulders, paper crown raising between eyes.
